lines.zh: 我压低身形，沿着草原逼近。
lines.en: I keep low and close in across the savanna.

lines.zh: 我的步子很轻，落地几乎无声。
lines.en: My steps are light, almost silent.

lines.zh: 我从灌木后绕出去，不停留。
lines.en: I slip past the brush without pausing.

lines.zh: 风把我的长发吹到脸前。
lines.en: The wind blows my long hair across my face.
I loosen my wrists as I walk.
I keep to tree shadow, off the main road.

lines.zh: 走过的地方，草只晃了一下。
lines.en: The grass barely stirs where I pass.

lines.zh: 我一步步量着这段距离。
lines.en: I measure this distance one step at a time.
I don't run; I wait for you to move.
I turn half a circle around you.

lines.zh: 脚下沙土一响，我就停住。
lines.en: A crunch of grit stops me dead.
I stand, clenching and unclenching my fists.
I look up and wait for the clouds to pass.

lines.zh: 这地方荒得连鸟都没有。
lines.en: This place is too barren even for birds.
My shoulders crack as I roll them.
I stare at the ridgeline far off.
The wind dies, and I grow warier.
I knock the dirt off my soles.
I crouch halfway to rest my legs.
I'm deciding whether to throw the first punch.
Someone passes; I don't look up.
I tuck my shirt hem into my belt.
I let out one long breath.
You're not from this savanna.
I know that stance of yours.
Put it down and I'll let you go.
I've been looking for you a long while.
Don't reach in your pocket; I'm watching.
Your ki is weak; you can't hide it.
These hands have had years of practice.
Stand still and let me read you.
You think beasts are all I fight?
Three steps back before you speak.
Your eyes keep away from mine. Guilty.

lines.zh: 这身衣服，不像走远路的。
lines.en: Those clothes aren't made for travel.
I don't talk much before a punch.

lines.zh: 你握拳的姿势，我一眼看穿。
lines.en: I see through your clenched-fist stance at a glance.
I'll count to three, then you decide.
I never strike from behind.
I'll give up the road, not my life.
Come on, show me something first.

lines.zh: 吃了这一下，我退了半步。
lines.en: That one put me half a step back.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把架子重新摆好。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and reset my guard.
It hurts, but nothing's broken.
I twist away from most of it.
I suck in a breath and steady my base.
I'll remember that one.
Don't think I only take hits.
My eyelid didn't even twitch.
Food? Put it on the ground first.
I don't take things and owe favors.

lines.zh: 你举着那袋子，是想收买我？
lines.en: Waving that bag at me, are you buying me?

lines.zh: 我饿，但我不抢路人的饭。
lines.en: I'm hungry, but I don't rob travelers of meals.

lines.zh: 这一点东西，不够我一天的力气。
lines.en: That's not a day's worth of strength.
Put the rations back.
I catch the smell of rice.
I don't eat for free; it's a trade.
Don't test me with a meal.
I can eat first, then we fight.
You bump me and I don't shift.
Keep off me; I strike fast.
I drop a shoulder and you give ground.
That knock rattled your pack.
I slide past your side.

lines.zh: 你的重量，我早就估过了。
lines.en: I already guessed your weight.

lines.zh: 两个人挤在树缝里，很局促。
lines.en: Two of us jammed in a gap between trees.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡下，脚已经后撤。
lines.en: I block with my arm and my foot already retreats.
You step on the top of my foot.
Make room; I don't like being touched.
I'm used to being on my own.
Among fellow students, no ceremony needed.
We stand back to back, each watching a side.

lines.zh: 他出手比我快，力气没我大。
lines.en: He's quicker than me, not as strong.
We meet behind the rocks.
I don't ask about his past.

lines.zh: 练拳的时候，我们互相喂招。
lines.en: When we train, we feed each other openings.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸声我听得出来。
lines.en: I can pick out his breathing.
We split one waterskin.
At dawn he's gone again.
I'll take this bag of rations.
A short blade; it'll do.

lines.zh: 我把地上的护腕捡起来。
lines.en: I pick the wrist wraps off the dirt.
I don't touch the coin purse.
I pick up the compass you dropped.
Good boots. Mine now.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时也没放松警惕。
lines.en: Even bending down, I stay alert.
I slip it into my belt pouch.

lines.zh: 地上有本书，我翻了两页。
lines.en: There's a book; I flip two pages.
I pick up a single copper coin.
Your ki is locked.
One push off my toes — now.
I raise my hand. Did you catch that?
Close enough; this is my fastest range.
I'll cut you off before you move.
I sink my hips.
This turn is exactly what I waited for.
Looking won't help you now.

lines.zh: 我的拳头已经开始动了。
lines.en: My fist is already moving.

lines.zh: 风从你侧面来，我顺着它上。
lines.en: The wind comes off your flank; I ride it in.
You're breathing too loud.
Right — three seconds are up.
I circle you, closing with each pass.

lines.zh: 你的脚一动，我就跟着动。
lines.en: When your foot moves, mine answers.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的肩膀，那里先动。
lines.en: I watch your shoulders; they move first.
Back up again and you're out of room.
No hurry; I've strength to spare.
My breathing has settled.
You shift stance; I shift mine.
I haven't lost a step.
You drop a shoulder before you punch.
I've closed off this road.
I herd you toward open ground.
Your knees are turning inward.

lines.zh: 我看见你手背上的青筋。
lines.en: I see the veins stand on the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 我退半步，是为了更好的角度。
lines.en: I give half a step for a better angle.

lines.zh: 再等一下，你就撑不住了。
lines.en: One more moment, and you'll break.

lines.zh: 我一拳打在你的架子上。
lines.en: My fist lands on your guard.

lines.zh: 狼牙风风拳，先给你三下。
lines.en: Wolf Fang Fist — three hits to start.
My hands are faster than your eyes.
That one whistles past your ear.
My kick takes your ankle.
You back away; I follow instantly.
My knuckles sweep your jaw.

lines.zh: 我连出两拳，你只挡住一拳。
lines.en: Two punches, and you block one.
My elbow jams into a gap in your armor.
That one wasn't full strength.

lines.zh: 我趁着你的空当往前压。
lines.en: I press in through your opening.
I drive you back two steps.

lines.zh: 拳风把你头发都吹起来。
lines.en: The wind of my punch lifts your hair.
Don't stand frozen; move.
This punch is what you're owed.

lines.zh: 我从土坡后站起来，拍拍手。
lines.en: I stand up behind the rise and dust my hands.

lines.zh: 草原上多了个不该在这里的人。
lines.en: An unlikely figure appears on the savanna.
I retie my belt.
I land with my knees bent.

lines.zh: 任务叫我来这里，我就来了。
lines.en: The mission sent me here, so here I am.
I roll my neck once.

lines.zh: 风迎面吹来，我甩了甩头发。
lines.en: Wind hits my face; I toss my hair back.

lines.zh: 我抬头，先看清对手在哪。
lines.en: I look up and find my opponent first.
No bystanders here. Good.
I clench my fists and my knuckles pop.

lines.zh: 我踩了两下地面，试试硬度。
lines.en: I stamp the ground twice to test it.

lines.zh: 远处有人影，我把重心压下去。
lines.en: A shape in the distance; I sink my weight.
I'm here, and I'm not here to talk.

lines.zh: 我站定时，草都朝一边倒。
lines.en: When I plant myself, the grass bends one way.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看太阳，记了时间。
lines.en: I check the sun and note the hour.

lines.zh: 这一带的风很适合出手。
lines.en: The wind here suits a fight.
Come on, let's see what you weigh.

lines.zh: 火烧到袖子，我甩手扑灭。
lines.en: Fire takes my sleeve; I shake it out.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，脚踝一沉。
lines.en: I drop from a height and my ankle takes the shock.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我闭气往上挣。
lines.en: Water floods in; I hold my breath and kick up.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推开，耳里一片嗡响。
lines.en: The blast shoves me back, ears ringing.

lines.zh: 一颗气弹擦过我的肋骨。
lines.en: A ki blast grazes my ribs.
Strange binding coils around my limbs.
Too long without food, and my punch goes soft.

lines.zh: 雷顺着胳膊走，我半身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning runs up my arm and half of me goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下空无一物，我抓不到任何东西。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; nothing to grab.
